name: Evangelisches Studienwerk: Scholarship for Doctoral Students
summary: Every year the Studienwerk funds scholarships and a wide range of educational programmes for about 300 German and foreign doctoral candidates of protestant faith from all disciplines. The grants are awarded in accordance with the guidelines
